license: LGPL-2.0-or-later; original file header and COPYING retained
necessity: Pinned Mach-O signing formats an unquoted output path into a 1024-byte shell command and terminates the libtcc caller on signing failure. This breaks retained builds in ordinary paths with spaces and permits truncation or shell interpretation.
owner: Existing TinyCC Mach-O output signing; no Rust ownership, frontend or backend replacement
change: One argv-based posix_spawnp request; waitpid observes that same child through EINTR; all signing errors return ordinary libtcc failure. No command shell, fixed path buffer, output copy, compiler fallback or signing retry.
runtime_scope: CONFIG_CODESIGN on Darwin; a controlled Linux build of the exact helper tests argv and status handling without claiming Mach-O support
performance_scope: One signer process replaces one shell plus signer; no benchmark or overall speed claim.
